Leafs GM Chayka Discusses Team's Obligations to Fans

Brad Treliving, the General Manager of the Toronto Maple Leafs, stated that the team aims to earn the love of its fans. He acknowledged the obligation that comes with managing the team he supported as a child. Treliving emphasized the importance of understanding this responsibility.
